name: Google Photos
summary: Automatic phone backup with search, face grouping and sharing. For many people, the only complete copy of a decade of photographs.

factors: It may hold the only copy of your photos
Albums, shared albums and partner sharing
Search, faces and memories that you have come to rely on
Storage shared with Gmail and Drive

export.summary: Google Takeout hands over everything, but as dozens of archive files with the metadata split into separate JSON files. The right import tool puts it back together.

methods.name: Google Takeout
methods.detail: Select only Google Photos, choose the largest archive size offered and download every part. Large libraries take hours to prepare and days to download.

caveats: Dates, locations and descriptions edited in Google Photos live in JSON sidecar files, not in the images
A photo appears once per album and again by year, so naive copying creates duplicates
'Storage saver' uploads are the compressed versions; originals you did not keep elsewhere are gone
Shared albums owned by other people are not included
Download links expire after about a week, and you need free disk space of two to three times the library size while importing

paths.verdict: The closest match to how Google Photos works, if you are willing to run a server and its backups.

import.summary: Run immich-go against the Takeout archives directly, without unpacking them. It matches the sidecar metadata, removes duplicates and recreates albums.

transfers: Photos and videos at the quality Google stored
Automatic backup from your phone from now on
lost: Face names: recognition runs again and you re-label
Shared albums and partner sharing, which you set up afresh
Edits made in Google Photos, unless saved as copies
Google's off-site redundancy: backups are now your job

paths.verdict: For people who want privacy without running anything: the hosted plan is the realistic option for most families.

import.summary: Ente's desktop app imports the unpacked Takeout folders directly, reading the JSON metadata and preserving albums.

transfers: Photos and videos at the quality Google stored
Automatic backup from your phone from now on
lost: Face names: recognition runs again on your devices
Shared albums, which you set up afresh
Edits made in Google Photos, unless saved as copies
Free storage beyond the small free tier

paths.verdict: For people who think in folders and want a browsable archive more than a phone backup service.

import.summary: Unpack the Takeout archives into PhotoPrism's import folder and run an import; it reads the JSON metadata files. Albums are not recreated, and you add a phone sync app separately.

transfers: Photos and videos at the quality Google stored
lost: Albums, which you rebuild by hand
Automatic phone backup, unless you add a sync app
